recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a concrete semantic mismatch in the active Appointment search-parameter source without broadening the issue scope or adding redundant narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-47677 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for Appointment recurrence search. PA decided that date search already covers materialized or virtualized recurring appointments, and that recurrence-series management should be supported by originating-appointment, previous-appointment, occurrence-changed, is-recurring, and has-recurrence-template search parameters.
initial_application: Commit 5041e81d6e8c50a3f8fd2e60e18be643dc7234d5 added the five requested Appointment search parameters to source/appointment/bundle-Appointment-search-params.xml. Commit e6239bb09ba6158b2c47856f21a8c73eb125af6f later adjusted the build path extension for Appointment-is-recurring as a compile fix.
additional_context: Appointment is active in source/fhir.ini, so the Appointment search-parameter bundle is in current build scope. PA September 2024 WGM minutes record FHIR-47677 discussion and a later 4-0-0 motion to approve the proposed solution. Bounded Jira and Zulip searches did not find a conflicting related decision.
reconciliation: The four direct search parameters were already present, and Appointment-is-recurring had the right description but used the FHIRPath union operator between two exists() booleans. The reconciliation changes that expression to logical OR so the token search parameter evaluates whether either recurrenceTemplate or originatingAppointment is present.
